metadata.title: API Development & Design - Sources
metadata.description: Primary standards and high-signal docs for REST, GraphQL, gRPC, AsyncAPI, and agent-facing API design guidance
metadata.freshness_policy: Re-verify specs and tooling entries every 90 days; RFCs are stable once finalized

standards_and_specs.name: RFC 9110 - HTTP Semantics
standards_and_specs.description: Canonical HTTP method semantics, caching, and safe/idempotent behavior

standards_and_specs.name: RFC 9457 - Problem Details for HTTP APIs
standards_and_specs.description: Standard error response format for HTTP APIs (obsoletes RFC 7807)

standards_and_specs.name: RFC 9745 - The Deprecation HTTP Response Header Field
standards_and_specs.description: Deprecation header; value is an RFC 9651 Structured Field Date (`Deprecation: @1688169599`), used with the RFC 8594 Sunset header

standards_and_specs.name: HTTPAPI Idempotency-Key Header Draft
standards_and_specs.description: IETF Internet-Draft, not an RFC; check datatracker for its current state. Idempotency-Key is a de facto convention whose semantics each API must document

standards_and_specs.name: RFC 6585 - Additional HTTP Status Codes (429 Too Many Requests)
standards_and_specs.description: Defines 429 Too Many Requests and related cache behavior

standards_and_specs.name: HTTPAPI RateLimit Headers Draft
standards_and_specs.description: IETF work defining two Structured Fields — `RateLimit` and `RateLimit-Policy` (recent drafts: `RateLimit-Policy: "default";q=100;w=60`, `RateLimit: "default";r=50;t=30`; params q, w, r, t, pk, qu) — replacing earlier drafts; check datatracker for the current revision and whether it has become an RFC

design_guides.name: Hands-On APIs for AI and Data Science (Ryan Day, O'Reilly, 2025)
design_guides.description: Book. Ch.1 'Designing APIs for Data Scientists' — the data-scientist consumer profile (JSON-first, SDK, standard external identifiers, strict type conformance, CSV/Parquet bulk download, last-changed-date delta parameter). Ch.12 'Designing APIs to Use with Generative AI and LLMs' — LLM-consumer rules: dedicated summary-statistics endpoints, language-first search over identifier lookup, and field pruning framed as an accuracy control. Directional heuristics only; ch.12 rules are attributed partly to Blobr's 'Is Your API AI-ready?' post and carry no magnitudes.
